# Trekly Design Notes

## Source

- ColorLib "Ecoland" — travel & tours landing page
- Preview: https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/ecoland/

## Tokens

- Primary: #007bff (blue, Bootstrap default)
- Font: Poppins (Google Fonts)
- Background: white sections alternating with #f8f9fa
- Buttons: blue bg, white text, rounded corners
- Cards: white bg, image-heavy, price badges

## Structure

12 sections total: Navbar, Hero (slider), Search form, Services (4-col), Stats counter,
Destination CTA (parallax), Best Places (5-col cards), Hotel CTA (parallax),
Nearest Hotels (2-col), Room Offers (4-col), Restaurant (3-col gallery), Blog (3-col), Footer

## Key patterns

- Parallax CTA sections use full-width background images with centered text
- Cards use overlay pattern: image with gradient + floating content
- Star ratings use filled/unfilled star icons
- Date display in blog uses day/month/year vertical stack
